name: monoline
description: Monoline: an open-source UI kit. Plain CSS core, accessible React components, docs, and an AI-readable registry.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @monoline/css && npm run build -w @monoline/react && npm run build -w apps/docs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @monoline/react && npm run typecheck -w apps/docs
scripts.check: npm run check -w @monoline/css && npm run typecheck && npm run test
